data.title: Duo Prestige Villas
data.about:
Introducing Duo Prestige Villas. Nestled in Damac Hills 2, these are the first-of-its kind villas with built-in conference room styled offices overlooking the green vistas of the community. These homes have the most amazing interiors and layouts.

The Duo Villas are an ideal place to work from home and yet have the peace of mind and space you need to concentrate. Here, your office is just a few step from your bedroom! Not just that, if these villas are not delivered on time, Damac guarantees return.

characteristics_module.title: Prestige Villas with Ensuite Offices
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Open View Rooftop Homes
  • Ideal place to work from home
  • Stunning sky views from the ensuite office & home
  • 3 BR starting at AED 1.27M
  • 4-year payment plan
  • Handover: Dec 2024
  • Guaranteed Payback if not delivered on time
  • Ample privacy & natural light
  • Lazy river, go-karting, paintball, zen garden, floating cinema and more amazing amenities

location_tile.title: Nestled within Damac Hills 2
location_tile.description:
Duo Prestige Villas are nestled within Damac Hills 2. Damac Hills 2 is nestled just minutes away from the majority of city’s landmarks.

  • 20 mins – Dubai Studio City | Arabian Ranches
  • 27 mins – Damac Hills
  • 30 mins – Academic City | Dubai Production City
  • 32 mins – Dubai Internet City
  • 36 mins – Dubai Marina
  • 40 mins – Downtown Dubai | Burj Khalifa | Dubai Mall
